lines.text: Why does that chat feel awful?

data.define: Describes people or places that make you feel bad.

misuse.text: Don't call spicy soup 'toxic' at dinner.
misuse.why: It means harmful, not just strong.

hook.text: Why does that chat feel awful?

publish.title: What does "toxic" mean?
publish.value: Toxic = Harmful to your mood. Example: "That group chat feels toxic." (casual English).
